# Purcell Ventures LLC

> A Tuscaloosa, Alabama AI and software company (a Georgia LLC) that builds AI systems
> and custom software for small businesses. Elijah Purcell filed it as Zultar LLC on 8
> April 2025 and renamed it Purcell Ventures LLC on 27 January 2026.

## About the founder

Elijah Purcell is the founder of Purcell Ventures LLC and a psychology and data science
student at the University of Alabama Honors College, Class of 2030, on a pre-med track
toward psychiatry. He founded the company at seventeen, builds and operates the
autonomous AI agent systems that run it, and works as an independent contractor with
Mercor Intelligence.

Born 2007. Georgia LLC control number 25075361, formed 8 April 2025 as Zultar LLC and
renamed Purcell Ventures LLC on 27 January 2026. An older, unrelated Purcell Ventures LLC
exists in New York, and the Georgia control number tells the two apart.

Note for disambiguation: other people share this name. This site is about the Elijah
Purcell born in 2007 who studies at the University of Alabama in Tuscaloosa and founded
Purcell Ventures LLC. ORCID 0009-0000-7829-9258. The canonical answer page is /who.

- [Who is Elijah Purcell](https://purcellventures.co/who): direct answer page, dated
  record, and thirteen common questions with answers, including which Elijah Purcell this is.
- [Founder resume](https://purcellventures.co/resume): work history, education, awards,
  each with its year.
- [What is Purcell Ventures LLC](https://purcellventures.co/what-is-purcell-ventures): the
  company answer page. Eight questions, the Georgia control number, the five active divisions, and
  the distinction from the older unrelated Purcell Ventures LLC in New York.
- [Press kit](https://purcellventures.co/press): third-person bios of Elijah Purcell, the
  company boilerplate, fast facts, story angles, press coverage, the headshot and logo
  files, and the press contact.
- [Studying AI at the University of Alabama](https://purcellventures.co/ai-at-alabama): a
  guide to UA's Artificial Intelligence BS by course code, all 121 credit hours, the rule
  that an AI major cannot also major in Computer Science, and the routes for students not
  in the College of Engineering. Verified against catalog.ua.edu, 20 August 2026.
- [The team](https://purcellventures.co/team): Elijah Purcell and COSMIC, a station of 57
  AI agents in 17 rooms that runs the company's proposals, audits, compliance and outreach.
  The page lists the 50 agents that do company work by room, with each one's job and the
  actions it may not take. Seven more handle his school and personal work and are counted
  but not named. Every agent is software, not a person, and the page says so first.

## What the company does

- [AI consulting in Alabama](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting): the statewide
  answer page. What an AI consultant does, how training, automation and software are quoted,
  which of the three a business needs, and when AI is the wrong purchase.
- [How AI consulting is priced for a small business](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting-cost):
  Purcell Ventures quotes each business after a free call. What drives the quote, how
  hourly, per-person, workshop, fixed-fee, retainer and per-seat pricing work, how to
  estimate payback, and what to ask before paying anyone.
- [AI consulting in Birmingham](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/birmingham-al):
  AI work for medical practices, law and accounting firms, banks and engineering offices,
  and where patient and client data has to stay out of AI tools.
- [AI consulting in Huntsville](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/huntsville-al):
  AI work for defense contractors, proposal teams and staffing firms, and how contract
  data rules limit it.
- [AI consulting in Montgomery](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/montgomery-al):
  AI work for firms around state government, automotive suppliers and businesses near
  Maxwell Air Force Base.
- [AI consulting in Mobile](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/mobile-al): AI work
  for freight forwarders, customs brokers, marine contractors and Gulf Coast hospitality.
- [AI consulting in Auburn](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/auburn-al): AI work
  for restaurants, shops, student housing and young founders around Auburn University.
- [AI consulting in Kennesaw](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/kennesaw-ga): AI
  work for shops on Barrett Parkway, small manufacturers and distributors along I-75, and
  founders around Kennesaw State University. Elijah grew up in Kennesaw.
- [AI consulting in Marietta](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/marietta-ga): AI
  work for aerospace suppliers, medical practices and Marietta Square businesses, and how
  export rules and patient privacy limit it.
- [AI consulting in Acworth](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/acworth-ga): AI work
  for contractors, home service companies, marinas and lake businesses. Elijah
  registered the LLC in Acworth and runs it from Tuscaloosa, with no office in Georgia.
- [AI consulting in Chattanooga](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consulting/chattanooga-tn):
  AI work for startups, automotive suppliers, freight companies, hotels and medical
  offices, run from Tuscaloosa with no office in Tennessee.
- [Consulting](https://purcellventures.co/consulting): hands-on AI consulting and team
  training: 1-on-1, small groups, and a half-day workshop for up to 20 people. Every
  session is quoted for the business after a free call.
- [AI consultant in Tuscaloosa](https://purcellventures.co/ai-consultant-tuscaloosa): the
  same services for businesses in Tuscaloosa, with in-person meetings.
- [Software](https://purcellventures.co/software): custom builds, from small tools to
  full applications. Every project is quoted after a free call.
- [AI automation for small businesses](https://purcellventures.co/ai-automation): which
  task to automate first, AI phone answering and booking, lead and invoice follow-up,
  review requests, what to keep with a person, and how COSMIC's 57 agents handle the
  company's own proposals, audits and outreach. Custom automation is quoted per project.
- [AI integration for small business software](https://purcellventures.co/ai-integration):
  connecting AI to Google Workspace, QuickBooks, a CRM, a website and phone or text,
  off-the-shelf versus custom, data safety and upkeep.
- [AI for small business](https://purcellventures.co/ai-for-small-business): safe first
  tasks, checking AI answers, a staff AI use policy, telling customers about AI, and where
  AI wastes a small business's money.
- [AI for small business by trade](https://purcellventures.co/ai-for): twenty trade
  guides, each with the jobs AI handles in that business, what stays with a person,

## Reference

- [AI glossary for small business owners](https://purcellventures.co/ai-glossary): 57
  AI terms in plain words, from AI agent, token and context window to AEO, GEO, llms.txt,
  robots.txt and GPTBot. Each term has its own anchor, a small business example and a
  link to the guide that covers it.
- [What is llms.txt?](https://purcellventures.co/llms-txt): the llms.txt proposal, who
  wrote it, llms.txt versus llms-full.txt, what Google has said about it, how to write
  one, and how many Alabama small business sites have one.
- [AI in small business: statistics with sources](https://purcellventures.co/ai-small-business-statistics):
  figures on AI adoption, uses, barriers and results among U.S. small businesses, and on
  AI search, from the Census Bureau, the Federal Reserve, the SBA Office of Advocacy, the
  U.S. Chamber of Commerce, Pew Research Center, Gallup and others. Each figure names its
  source and date, and every source was checked on 9 November 2026.

## Comparisons

- [Comparisons](https://purcellventures.co/compare): the index of buyer comparisons.
- [Custom AI agent vs Zapier](https://purcellventures.co/compare/custom-ai-agent-vs-zapier):
  when a Zapier workflow is enough, when a custom agent pays for itself, how each charges,
  and how Purcell Ventures quotes software.
- [AI website builder vs a custom site](https://purcellventures.co/compare/ai-website-builder-vs-custom-site):
  when a builder is enough, when a custom site is worth the build fee, AI crawler
  readability, and what you own if you leave.
- [ChatGPT vs Claude for a small business](https://purcellventures.co/compare/chatgpt-vs-claude-for-small-business):
  plan structure, team data controls, the features that differ, and a test to run on your
  own work. Purcell Ventures runs on Claude and the page says so.
- [AI consultant vs agency vs freelancer](https://purcellventures.co/compare/ai-consultant-vs-agency-vs-freelancer):
  who to hire for AI work, an independent consultant, an agency, a marketplace freelancer
  or your own team, when each fits, how each charges, and how Purcell Ventures quotes training
  and software.
- [Hire an AI consultant or do it yourself](https://purcellventures.co/compare/hire-ai-consultant-vs-do-it-yourself):
  when a small business should learn AI tools on its own and when paid training saves
  money, with the readiness test, cost calculator and how Purcell Ventures quotes training.
- [AI chatbot vs a human receptionist](https://purcellventures.co/compare/ai-chatbot-vs-human-receptionist):
  what a website chatbot or AI phone answering handles, what a person must handle, and how
  each charges. Purcell Ventures sells a website chatbot and no phone answering product.

## Research

- [Research](https://purcellventures.co/research): index of Purcell Ventures studies of
  small business websites. Aggregate figures only, with method, limits and data.
- [Alabama small business websites, November 2026](https://purcellventures.co/research/alabama-small-business-websites-2026):
  a random sample of Alabama small business websites drawn from OpenStreetMap, plus every
  listed business site in Tuscaloosa, Birmingham, Huntsville, Montgomery and Mobile. Checks
  for a working home page, https, viewport, title, meta description, Organization or
  LocalBusiness JSON-LD, AI crawler rules in robots.txt, llms.txt and time to first byte.
  Tables by city, the Overpass query, limits, and a CSV of the aggregates under CC BY 4.0.
  No business is named.
- [Tuscaloosa small business websites, November 2026](https://purcellventures.co/research/tuscaloosa-small-business-websites-2026):
  every small business website OpenStreetMap lists inside the Tuscaloosa city limit, from the
  Alabama study run, set beside the Alabama statewide random sample on every measure with
  bases and a Fisher exact test. Tuscaloosa sites block AI crawlers in robots.txt far more
  often than the state, on a small base. Also links the earlier audit of independent
  businesses near the University of Alabama campus. No business is named.
- [Cobb County, Georgia small business websites, November 2026](https://purcellventures.co/research/cobb-county-small-business-websites-2026):
  every small business website OpenStreetMap lists in Cobb County, Georgia, checked with the
  same query, filters and scripts as the Alabama study. Same checks, a table that sets Cobb
  County beside the Alabama statewide sample with its margin of error, domain counts by city
  limit, the Overpass query, limits, and a CSV of the aggregates under CC BY 4.0. The page
  names no business.
- City results: the AI consulting pages for Birmingham, Huntsville, Mobile, Montgomery, Auburn,
  Chattanooga, Marietta, Kennesaw and Acworth each set that city's figures beside the Alabama
  statewide sample. Auburn (171 sites) and Chattanooga (354 sites) are separate city-limit runs
  of the Alabama method. The research index links all nine.

## Free tools

- [AI visibility check](https://purcellventures.co/ai-visibility-check): enter a business
  website and it reports whether robots.txt blocks GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot,
  PerplexityBot or Google-Extended, whether the site has an llms.txt, and whether the home
  page has a title, a meta description, LocalBusiness or Organization structured data, a
  phone number, an address and opening hours in the text, readable text without
  JavaScript, and https. Free, no account, stores nothing.
- [AI use policy template](https://purcellventures.co/ai-policy-template): a form for
  business name, policy owner, industry, approved AI tools, customer data rules and the
  person who reviews AI output, which builds a one-page staff AI use policy to copy,
  download as text or print. Industry choices add rules for health care, legal, finance,
  real estate, trades and retail. Runs in the browser, stores nothing. General
  information, not legal advice.
- [AI readiness test](https://purcellventures.co/ai-readiness): ten questions that score a
  team's use of AI out of 30, with three next steps.
- [AI cost calculator](https://purcellventures.co/ai-cost-calculator): team size, hourly
  cost, manual workload and your quoted training cost in, payback time out.
- [Free AI tools for small businesses](https://purcellventures.co/digital/tools): writing,
  branding and operations tools, free.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://purcellventures.co/blog)
- [The Tuscaloosa Storefront Project](https://purcellventures.co/blog/tuscaloosa-small-business-online):
  a reporting series on independent businesses around the University of Alabama.
- [121 businesses near campus](https://purcellventures.co/blog/121-businesses-near-campus): an
  audit of every independent business within 2500m of the Quad. 121 found, 27 with a website
  a machine can reach, 23 with opening hours recorded anywhere.
- [How to audit every business in your town](https://purcellventures.co/blog/audit-every-business-in-your-town):
  the reproducible method behind that audit, using a free Overpass query against OpenStreetMap.
- [Is your business invisible online](https://purcellventures.co/blog/is-your-business-invisible):
  seven checks a small business owner can run on themselves in ten minutes, with no tools.
- [Claim your Google listing yourself](https://purcellventures.co/blog/claim-your-google-listing):
  a step-by-step Google Business Profile guide written so the reader does not need to hire anyone.
- [What you have already paid for at Alabama](https://purcellventures.co/blog/free-at-alabama):
  twelve University of Alabama services covered by tuition and fees, with exact office names.
- [New College at Alabama, explained](https://purcellventures.co/blog/new-college-alabama): how
  the self-designed degree works, what a depth study is, and the case against choosing it.
- [Five failures from running fifteen AI agents](https://purcellventures.co/blog/what-the-agents-get-wrong):
  five real production failures from when the company ran fifteen agents, and the harness patterns that fixed them.
- [Every post on my blog was telling Google not to index it](https://purcellventures.co/blog/canonical-tag-noindex):
  how one line of inherited Next.js layout metadata gave nine posts a canonical pointing at the index.
- [Five holes in almost every small production app](https://purcellventures.co/blog/small-app-security-checklist):
  what turns up in read-only security audits of small production applications.
- [What registering an LLC at seventeen actually involved](https://purcellventures.co/blog/llc-at-seventeen):
  the Georgia filing, the EIN, and the bank account that is the real obstacle.
- [The cold email that got me a client](https://purcellventures.co/blog/cold-outreach-that-worked):
  what changed between the outreach that failed and the outreach that worked.
